Extracts the basin of an outlet: the cells that drain into it along the drainage directions. Ported from the r.water.outlet module of GRASS GIS.

**Toolbox folder:** Dem Manipulation<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Basin, Outlet, Drainage directions<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Wateroutlet`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pNorth` | double |  | `-1.0` | The northing of the outlet, in the coordinates of the map. |
| `pEast` | double |  | `-1.0` | The easting of the outlet, in the coordinates of the map. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outBasin` | output file |  | The map of the basin: 1 inside, no-data outside. |
| `outArea` | double | m² | The area of the basin. |
